cases.name: a-widget-reads-its-layout-and-a-push-button-whether-it-holds-a-picture
cases.covers: All seven layouts, the default and one past them read; a push button reads hasImage, another kind has no such fact.

cases.name: a-create-and-a-widget-update-write-any-layout
cases.covers: A create writes each of the seven layouts, a button left without one reads caption, and a widget update writes another.

cases.name: a-layout-goes-on-a-push-button-only
cases.covers: A layout on another kind's widget is refused, its row's null is no change, and a push button's null is refused.

cases.name: a-png-becomes-the-picture-of-every-widget
cases.covers: A png becomes the picture of every widget of a new push button, whose layouts stay.

cases.name: a-jpeg-becomes-the-picture-of-every-widget
cases.covers: A jpeg becomes the picture of every widget of a new push button, whose layouts stay.

cases.name: a-pdf-becomes-the-picture-of-every-widget
cases.covers: A pdf becomes the picture of every widget of a new push button, whose layouts stay.

cases.name: null-takes-the-picture-out
cases.covers: null takes the picture out; again it leaves a field with none as it is; another app's icon comes out the same way.

cases.name: each-widget-keeps-its-layout
cases.covers: A button with an image widget and a caption widget takes the picture in both; each keeps its layout.

cases.name: the-picture-is-one-drawing-for-buttons-marks-and-stamps
cases.covers: Three buttons, two signature marks and a stamp of one PNG: the later ones place the drawing the first made.

cases.name: it-takes-a-push-button-and-a-picture
cases.covers: Another kind is refused both ways, a field the form lacks is not found, and a two-page PDF or other bytes are no picture.

cases.name: it-is-one-change-with-one-undo
cases.covers: The picture as an op of a change, one forms.updated; its undo takes it out, and that undo puts it back.

cases.name: it-is-filling-in-the-buyer
cases.covers: The buyer fills in the buyer's image field and no one else's.

cases.name: it-is-filling-in-the-filler
cases.covers: doc.forms.fill fills in any image field.

cases.name: a-place-added-later-shows-the-picture
cases.covers: addWidget gives a push button's new place its picture, in the layout it names.

cases.name: a-place-added-without-a-layout-keeps-the-picture
cases.covers: A place added without a layout shows its caption and holds the picture.

cases.name: undoing-the-added-place
cases.covers: Undoing the added place takes it away; the picture stays in the others.

cases.name: a-merged-field-splits-for-a-new-place
cases.covers: A field and widget in one object split for a new place, and both show the picture.

cases.name: a-copy-keeps-the-picture-with-its-value
cases.covers: A copy keeps the picture with its value and its layout always; one without values keeps the layout alone.
